I find myself just staring out the window, sometimes even tearing up a bit, and I don't even know why. Feels like the hope has just been drained out of me. I used to love working the land, but now… it just feels like too much. Hard to get myself going, hard to even pretend things are okay. The tractor feels heavier, and decisions feel monumental. I just keep thinking about what we lost, and what it means for the future.
